source: One single-reviewer run of the production-files proof on its seeded production files, made through the review kit's single form on the mid-tier model by production_files_review_proof.py; wall time, cost and tokens are the kit's figures for the one session of the run.

seeds.description: U3, the small-outline amplifier, turned 90 degrees in the placement file from the 0 its footprint is placed at on the board
D1, the polarised suppressor diode, reversed in the placement file, turned 180 degrees from the board's placement
U4, the controller in a leadless package with a pin-one marker, turned a quarter turn in the placement file from the board's placement
R4, a resistor, moved 4 mm along X in the placement file from where the board places it
R2's catalogue number in the parts list replaced by a number no position of the design carries, C9000099, the parts specification record mapping R2 to its own
the solder mask on both sides without its openings over the mains terminal block J1's through-hole pads, so the mask covers them
the mounting hole H1 moved 4 mm along X and Y in the board the layers are exported from, so its drilled hole and its mask openings on both sides stand 4 mm from the design's
every text on the front legend, the reference designators, exported mirrored

unmatched: G1.r1: 2 | FID1 | FID1 (32,-41) is in the placement file and in the parts specification record (C9000032) but has no row in production/parts-list.csv, which names no fiducial.
